description: Notes and links from the book club meetings
summary: I keep this around as a low-commitment way to stay current on LLM inference and AI-engineering literature without having to grind through a whole book solo. The AI Engineering and LLM Inference Illustrated tracks map directly onto the problems I hit when routing agent sessions and tuning local models, and the format is just markdown files linking to a few slides and a recording per chapter, so I can pull one session's notes into a doc the moment a specific question comes up. It's the kind of structured, no-hype peer reading group that I find more useful than any conference track.
